test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 declares the instant divorce granted by pronouncement of talaq three times as void and illegal. It provides for imprisonment for a term up to _________ and fine to the husband who practiced instant Triple Talaq.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019:-**

 
 
• It protects Married Women.
 
• The act takes all declarations of talaq, including in written or electronic form, to be void.
 
• **The act makes declaration of talaq a cognizable offence, attracting up to three years’ imprisonment with a fine. (Hence option 3 is correct)**
 
• Under this act, only Magistrate can grant bail to the accused.
 
• If the Women requests, then the offence may be compounded by the Magistrate.
 
• The custody of the minor children will also be determined by the Magistrate.
 
• Muslim women are entitled to seek Subsistence Allowance.
 
• **The Act renders instant triple talaq illegal and void, and also provides for maintenance to the woman and her dependent children. **
 
• This law was developed following a landmark 2017 ruling by the Supreme Court of India that found the practice of instant triple talaq unconstitutional.
